definitions.gloss: grimace; sour face; frown; displeased expression
definitions.explanation: A facial expression showing displeasure, reluctance, or dissatisfaction. A furrowed brow or tight-lipped look.

notes:
{渋面|じゅうめん} describes a facial expression showing displeasure, reluctance, or dissatisfaction — a grimace or sour look.

ETYMOLOGY:
{渋|じゅう} (astringent/reluctant, on'yomi of ⟦{渋|しぶ}い→渋い：06820_shibui⟧) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (face)

REGISTER:
{渋面|じゅうめん} is a formal, literary word. In everyday conversation, ⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ or しかめ{面|づら} is more natural. {渋面|じゅうめん} appears frequently in novels and news articles.
